item.title: Webinar: 2026 Hiring Trends and Job Market Signals
item.description: This webinar provides a clear-eyed assessment of current hiring conditions across biopharma, exploring which roles and skills are in demand, where opportunities are emerging, and how hiring practices are evolving.

item.title: Hiring Outlook: January Brings Year-Over-Year Layoff Decline
item.description: Last month, biopharmas let go or projected they would let go of less than 500 people combined, based on BioSpace estimates, down almost 1,000 from January 2025. Still, competition for open jobs remains strong, with employed and unemployed biotech and pharma professionals eyeing their next roles.

item.title: 7 Key Insights Into the 2026 Job Market and Hiring Landscape
item.description: Biopharma professionals need to understand today’s job market and how they can stand out to position themselves for success. Three talent acquisition and recruiting experts discussed these topics in a BioSpace webinar, from the importance of contract work to the value of an advocate.

item.title: 2025 Q4 Job Market Report: Positive Signs Emerge for Job Seekers
item.description: BioSpace data show job postings live increased quarter over quarter, while layoffs fell year over year.

item.title: 8 Things Job Candidates Say—or Don’t Say—That Turn Hiring Managers Off
item.description: In a competitive job market, how applicants present themselves in interviews is critical. Asking about promotions and expressing dislike for the work they’d be doing are just a few reasons hiring managers don’t extend job offers.
